summary: The commenter urges the FCC to condition E‑Rate funding on screen‑time limits, network‑level filtering of harmful content, and parent opt‑out of school‑issued devices, arguing that these measures will protect children and improve educational outcomes. No explicit policy claims about E‑Rate topics are present in the provided text. The commenter proposes that E‑Rate funding be conditioned on age‑based daily screen‑time limits in schools, citing health guidance and classroom distraction concerns. The comment argues for stricter screen‑time limits and network‑level filtering to protect students from harmful content, citing studies on pornography exposure and the benefits of reduced screen use. The comment argues that the FCC should revise its 2011 CIPA order to allow schools to block social‑media platforms during instructional hours and to condition E‑Rate funding on preventing recreational use of such platforms on funded networks. The comment argues that social media sites should be blocked on school‑provided Wi‑Fi and that daily screen‑time limits should be imposed under CIPA to protect students.
